name: liminal-notes
description: Local-first, Markdown-based note-taking app with Obsidian-style linking, built with Tauri + React + TypeScript.

scripts.lint: echo "(lint to be added by tooling)"
scripts.test: echo "(tests to be added by tooling)"
scripts.ci:test:package:core-shared: mkdir -p test-results/packages && pnpm --filter @liminal-notes/core-shared exec vitest run --reporter=default --reporter=junit --outputFile.junit=../../test-results/packages/core-shared.junit.xml
scripts.ci:test:package:vault-core: mkdir -p test-results/packages && pnpm --filter @liminal-notes/vault-core exec vitest run --reporter=default --reporter=junit --outputFile.junit=../../test-results/packages/vault-core.junit.xml
scripts.ci:test:package:reminders-core: mkdir -p test-results/packages && pnpm --filter @liminal-notes/reminders-core exec vitest run --reporter=default --reporter=junit --outputFile.junit=../../test-results/packages/reminders-core.junit.xml
scripts.ci:test:packages: pnpm run ci:test:package:core-shared && pnpm run ci:test:package:vault-core && pnpm run ci:test:package:reminders-core
scripts.ci:test:all: pnpm run ci:test:packages && pnpm run ci:lint:desktop && pnpm run ci:typecheck:desktop && pnpm run ci:test:desktop && pnpm run ci:test:rust
scripts.build:appimage:portable: cd apps/desktop && TAURI_BUNDLER_NEW_APPIMAGE_FORMAT=${TAURI_BUNDLER_NEW_APPIMAGE_FORMAT:-true} TAURI_BUNDLE_TARGETS=appimage cargo tauri build
